Definition: feminine of a derivative (at the second stage) from the same as G2218; a fastening (tiller-rope):--band.
BiblicalUsage: A band, a fastening — the tiller-rope of a ship — is the word's one meaning, and it appears once, in the storm off Malta. When the sailors loose the rudder bands and hoist the sail toward shore, the ship runs aground exactly as Paul said it would. The rope is loosed, and the wreck comes anyway.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the bands teach me something about God's warnings: loosing the ropes does not change the course He already named.
